name: El Racon
summary: El Racon is an online text-based mafia RPG with a tower defense mode, set in a fictional 1950s noir coast. Players start at their father's funeral and work their way up to Don: training stats, pulling jobs, buying shops and properties, travelling and trading between five fictional port cities, fighting and robbing other players, racing stolen cars and auctioning goods on the black market. Families pool money, raid rival businesses and take over cities. At night players defend the family villa in a path-based tower defense mode, placing their men on defensive posts and holding the gates until dawn. Seasons end every five weeks, with top bosses and families entering a permanent Hall of Fame, and a branching story campaign remembers the player's choices. Free to play with optional in-app purchases, no ads, available in 13 languages.
